name: christmas_star
source: Christmas/solidcraft/christmas_star.sc (SolidCraft 0.45; Jan's Christmas_star_v1.sc). Equations, lamp sources and checks: star_spec.md

shape._comment: constants of the .sc. Points: kd skirt depth / a (at least what the magnets need), magnets (dm diameter, hm height, the press fit is the parameter magnet_fit (pocket dm + magnet_fit), mrec magnet face below the wall, mskin wall behind the pocket; the skirt wall is hm + mrec + mskin), ksb pocket offset along the edge / a, kvb pocket centre down the wall / d. Lamp socket and carrier: tp plate, tw carrier tube wall, cr radial and cz axial clearance, lug_l lug length beyond the opening (lug_l_small below 25 mm opening), lug_e lug edge height, lug_w lug angle (deg), lock turn (deg), cl notch clearance, stop_w stop width (deg), ramp_i detent interference, cone_w carrier cone beyond the opening, rim_h carrier rim height, cord_d cord holes, sleeve_w sleeve wall

lamps._comment: seat: sleeve (holder pushed into a sleeve of the socket, its collar on a seat ledge_d, pulled out upwards with the bulb; holder_l: its length) or bayonet (holder clamped through the carrier: top part above, bottom part below). hole_d: bore of the sleeve or the carrier; bottom_d: the part under the carrier (flange or printed nut); top_d: the part on top (clamp ring, shade ring), keeps the cord holes free; envelope: what hangs below the plate (sleeve) or the carrier (bayonet), top down, as [diameter, length, clearance]; a_lamp: smallest edge a at which the envelope keeps its clearances from every part (node/star_lamps.mjs, exact B-rep distances)
